title: Team Lead - Sales
jobDescription: Role Overview Lead Elecbits' frontline sales engine by managing a team of Key Account Managers, owning revenue targets, building strong pipeline systems, driving enterprise closures, and ensuring predictable growth across assigned regions, sectors, or customer segments. This is a leadership position responsible for scaling business, building a high-performance team, improving sales discipline, and driving strategic growth across: ODM Solutions Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) Box Build Programs Product Engineering Services Strategic sourcing / manufacturing partnerships Preferred Skills Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Electronics, Mechanical, Business Administration, or related field MBA preferred but not mandatory 8–14 years of B2B sales experience Minimum 2+ years of team handling experience preferred Strong exposure to electronics manufacturing, ODM, EMS, industrial sales, product engineering, or solution selling. Proven track record of owning large revenue targets Strong forecasting, review management, and funnel governance capability Strong people leadership and coaching skills Excellent negotiation and enterprise account handling ability Strong communication, executive presence, and presentation skills High ownership and growth mindset Comfortable with regular travel for customer meetings and market expansion Think you might be a fit?

title: Sr. Project Manager
jobDescription: requirements — across hardware, firmware, mechanical, testing, quality and certification — through to a manufacturing-ready handover. The work rewards sharp requirement-sensing, fast learning of new domains, and tight orchestration across engineering teams and vendors. The Senior Project Manager owns exactly that. Role Summary We're hiring a Senior Project Manager to own a portfolio of ODM projects end-to-end, from concept to deployment. You'll be the single point of accountability for scope, cost, timeline and quality across multiple projects, the primary face to the client, and the force that keeps firmware, hardware, testing, quality and vendors moving in sync. Beyond delivery, you'll bring — strategy, customer empathy and data-driven decisions — to every engagement, mentor junior PMs, and build the SOPs that let the practice scale. Key Responsibilities Product Vision, Strategy & Roadmap: Translate each client brief and the surrounding market into a clear product strategy, roadmap and prioritised plan, aligning every project to defined business outcomes and a compelling product narrative. Identify near- and long-term opportunities, validate the market and cost case, and secure buy-in from clients and internal leadership for the chosen direction and its trade-offs. Project Ownership & Delivery: Own a portfolio of ODM projects from concept through deployment, serving as the single point of accountability for scope, cost, schedule, quality and customer satisfaction. Establish each project's plan, milestones and critical path, define clear success criteria, and govern delivery by monitoring KPIs, surfacing variances early, and initiating corrective action. New Product Development (NPD): Drive products through the full lifecycle — concept, design, prototyping, validation, certification and transfer to manufacturing — clearing each stage-gate with crisp entry and exit criteria. Govern design reviews and validation cycles, ensuring design-for-manufacturability, cost targets and compliance are met before production handover. Customer Empathy & Market Insight: Develop deep understanding of client and end-user needs, integrating user research, usage context and competitive analysis into requirements that maximise product impact. Build domain fluency quickly for new or unfamiliar products to scope accurately, anticipate engineering and non-engineering risks, and brief clients and teams with authority. Data-Informed Decisions & Prioritisation: Define the metrics that matter for each project, instrument them, and let data drive prioritisation, trade-offs and go/no-go decisions. Evaluate cost, design and schedule trade-offs with sound judgement, prioritise ruthlessly, and decide when to invest, pivot or stop. Cross-Functional Leadership & Influence: Lead internal teams across the product lifecycle — sequencing dependencies, resolving blockers, and driving alignment through influence while keeping team health high. Manage multiple concurrent projects, balancing shared engineering and vendor capacity against competing priorities and deadlines. Client & Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary face to the client and the voice of the customer internally, managing expectations, communicating progress and risk proactively, and leading resolution when commitments are challenged. Influence senior stakeholders with structured, extremely clear communication and data-backed storytelling, escalating roadblocks early with recommended options. Team Leadership & Process Excellence: Mentor and develop junior project managers — delegating execution, coaching judgement, and building their capability to own projects independently. Establish and evolve SOPs, playbooks, templates and documentation standards that raise the bar and enable consistent, repeatable, scalable delivery, capturing post-launch learnings for the next projects. Must-Have Skills 6–10 years in project or product management, owning complex cross-functional projects end-to-end in a fast-paced environment Bachelor's degree in engineering, business management, or a related field (Master's a plus) Strategic thinker who also executes — sets product direction and drives day-to-day delivery Customer-obsessed and data-informed — defines success metrics and uses data to drive decisions and trade-offs Structured problem-solving and bias-for action to drive early closures Proven track-record with cross-function collaboration and leadership Fluent in PM methodologies and tools (Agile/Scrum or Stage-Gate; JIRA, Confluence, MS Project) and product lifecycle / NPI concepts. Electronics or hardware background, or hands-on experience with electronic products (Io T, power electronics, consumer electronics). Experience in an ODM, product-development, EMS or hardware-startup environment. Experience managing vendors and mentoring other project managers. Think you might be a fit?

title: Sr. Firmware Engineer
jobDescription: Key Responsibilities Firmware Architecture & Development: Design and develop optimized bare-metal and RTOS-based firmware for embedded hardware platforms. Own the full firmware lifecycle from architecture through production release. Make architectural decisions around memory, power, and real-time performance trade-offs. Drivers & Peripheral Integration: Develop and maintain low-level drivers for on-chip and external peripherals (SPI, I2C, UART, ADC, etc.). Integrate and tune wireless stacks such as BLE and Wi-Fi. Optimize driver performance for latency, throughput, and power consumption. OTA, Code Quality & Reviews: Design and implement secure OTA (over-the-air) update mechanisms. Conduct peer code reviews and uphold coding standards across the firmware codebase. Write and maintain unit tests to ensure regression-free releases. Debugging & Manufacturing Support: Debug complex hardware-firmware integration issues using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and JTAG tools. Support manufacturing bring-up and assist production teams during early builds. Diagnose and resolve field issues in collaboration with hardware and QA teams. Preferred Skills 5–10 years of professional embedded firmware development experience Familiarity with wireless stacks (BLE, Wi-Fi) and Io T application protocols (MQTT/Co AP) Strong proficiency in C and C++ for resource-constrained environments Hands-on experience with RTOS (Free RTOS, Zephyr, Thread X) Working knowledge of ARM Cortex-M MCUs (STM32, n RF52, ESP32, NXP, or TI CC series) Comfortable with Git-based version control workflows Unit testing experience preferred Experience with cloud Io T platforms (AWS Io T Core, Azure Io T Hub, GCP Io T) Exposure to edge computing — local inference, edge-to-cloud sync, fleet management Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines for embedded targets. Think you might be a fit?

title: Sr. Hardware Engineer
jobDescription: Key Responsibilities Power Architecture & Conversion Design: Define hardware and power architecture; design SMPS, AC-DC and DC-DC converters across topologies (buck, boost, buck-boost, SEPIC, flyback, forward, LLC, push-pull). Add soft-start, current limiting, synchronous rectification, snubbers and EMI filters; select magnetics, MOSFETs, Ga N/Si C devices and gate drivers. Design battery systems — BMS, cell balancing, fuel gauging, USB-PD and Qi wireless charging. Perform loop compensation, Bode/stability analysis, transient response and thermal optimization. RF & Wireless Design: Design RF front-ends — LNAs, PAs, mixers, VCO/PLL and SAW/BAW/LC filters. Perform impedance matching, Smith chart / S-parameter analysis, link budget, sensitivity and phase-noise analysis. Integrate wireless technologies — BLE, Wi-Fi 6/6E/7, Lo Ra, NB-Io T/LTE-M, 5G, GNSS, UWB and NFC; design and tune PCB / chip antennas for return loss, radiation pattern and MIMO/diversity. Schematic Capture & PCB Layout: Lead schematic capture and PCB layout for motherboards, daughter cards and high-end multi-layer boards with semi-complex routing. Own controlled impedance, microstrip/stripline, via stitching, copper pour, switching-node minimization, return-path optimization and plane partitioning. Specify high-frequency laminates (Rogers, Taconic), stackups, isolation, creepage/clearance and surge/ESD protection. Compliance, Validation & Production: Drive EMI/EMC design per CISPR, FCC Part 15, IEC 61000, IEC 62368; ensure SAR and energy-efficiency compliance (DOE Level VI, Co C Tier 2). Lead regulatory pre-compliance for FCC, CE/RED, IC, TELEC, BIS, WPC and UL. Conduct RF bench testing (VNA, spectrum analyzer, signal generator, anechoic chamber) and OTA/conducted RF testing (EVM, ACPR). Perform power validation with oscilloscopes, electronic loads, power analyzers, LCR meters, EMI receivers/LISN and thermal imaging. Manage component selection, BOM optimization and sourcing with DFM/DFMA awareness; support DVT/EVT/PVT and NPI. Collaborate with firmware and mechanical teams on prototype bring-up; lead design reviews, own documentation and mentor junior engineers. Preferred Skills 5–10 years in hardware engineering with power electronics, RF and mixed-signal high-frequency PCB design experience Hands-on with motherboards, daughter cards and high-end multi-layer boards involving semi-complex routing Proficiency in schematic and PCB tools — Altium Designer, Cadence Or CAD/Allegro or Ki Cad Power simulation — LTspice, PSpice, Simetrix or PLECS; experience with Ga N/Si C-based high-efficiency designs RF simulation — Keysight ADS, Ansys HFSS, CST Studio or AWR Microwave Office; exposure to 5G mm Wave or UWB design Working knowledge of MATLAB/Simulink for RF/system modeling and thermal simulators (Ansys Icepak or equivalent) Experience taking wireless products through full certification cycles; familiarity with EMC standards (FCC/CE) and regulatory workflows Prior work on USB-PD, fast-charging or wireless power products; NPI experience in high-volume consumer, industrial or automotive products Hands-on bring-up, bench debug, RF and high-current measurement experience BOM costing and DFx awareness. Think you might be a fit?
